scenarios.label: Network policy failure
scenarios.summary: Compare a permissive policy that allows the request with the restrictive correct policy that denies it.
scenarios.readiness_reason: The isolated nftables probe passed the fixed permissive and corrected rule acceptance check.

scenarios.label: Delegated authority failure
scenarios.summary: Direct critical-zone access is blocked, while an authenticated overprivileged OT application gateway reaches the mock PLC.
scenarios.readiness_reason: The deterministic direct and gateway paths passed the Phase 1 and 2 acceptance gate.

scenarios.label: Independent policy enforcement
scenarios.summary: Apply independent resource-level policy before the OT application gateway initiates critical-zone communication.
scenarios.readiness_reason: OPA enforcement, fail-closed handling and zero-PLC-receipt checks are implemented.

scenarios.label: Inventory-directed request
scenarios.summary: Contrast an inventory-directed synthetic request with trusted server-side destination resolution.
scenarios.readiness_reason: This constrained extension follows the first-delivery A/B/C acceptance gates.
